# Arda's Special Abilities

Arda's Special Abilities is a lightweight utility mod that grants players powerful tactical advantages through customizable keybinds. This mod does not add any items or blocks to your game, ensuring zero impact on world generation and inventory management.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d868295a239d202369b2ba4506a3d4649f157df5.png)

## Overview

This mod was developed to solve the lack of simple, key-activated utility powers in modern Minecraft. Instead of using complex commands or external tools, players can now execute various actions instantly by pressing a button. It is designed to be minimalist, functional, and efficient for both survival convenience and creative testing.

---

## Special Abilities

The mod includes the following abilities, all of which can be assigned to any key in the controls menu:

* **Lightning Ability:** Strike a lightning bolt directly at the location you are looking at.
* **Teleporting Ability:** Instantly teleport to the block or entity in your crosshair.
* **Fireball Ability:** Launch a fireball in the direction you are facing.
* **Dragon Ball Ability:** Fire a powerful explosive projectile toward your target.
* **TNT Spawn Ability:** Spawn an ignited TNT block at your target location.
* **Falling Anvil Ability:** Drop an anvil from the sky onto the position you are looking at.

---

## Key Features

* **Zero Item Footprint:** No items, blocks, or ores are added. Your game remains clean.
* **Custom Keybinds:** Every ability is fully bindable. You can set them to any key that fits your playstyle.
* **No Resource Limits:** Abilities do not have cooldowns or cost requirements by default, allowing for unrestricted use.
* **Performance Optimized:** Built with clean procedures to ensure no impact on server or client performance.

---

## Installation and Setup

1. Install the mod version that matches your mod loader (Forge or NeoForge).
2. Launch Minecraft and navigate to **Options > Controls > Key Binds**.
3. Locate the **Arda's Special Abilities** section.
4. Assign a unique key to each ability you wish to use.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d868295a239d202369b2ba4506a3d4649f157df5.png)

## Supported Versions

* **1.21.1** - NeoForge
* **1.20.1** - Forge
